claims.text: Defense Intelligence Reference Document titled "Concepts for Extracting Energy From the Quantum Vacuum", series "Acquisition Threat Support", published 2010-04-06 with an Intelligence Cut-Off Date (ICOD) of 2009-12-01, DIA document number DIA-08-1004-007. Released by DIA under FOIA and posted in the DIA FOIA Electronic Reading Room.

Inside cover reads: "This product is one in a series of advanced technology reports produced in FY 2009 under the Defense Intelligence Agency [redacted b(3) 10 USC 424] Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications (AAWSA) Program" and directs questions to the "AAWSA Program Manager, Defense Intelligence Agency, ATTN: [redacted], Bldg 6000, Washington, DC 20340-5100".

Author name is withheld in the DIA-released copy under FOIA exemption (b)(6); the "Prepared by:" line is withheld under (b)(3) 10 USC 424. The released cover therefore does not attribute the DIRD to a named author.
Released PDF is 57 pages, marked UNCLASSIFIED//FOR OFFICIAL USE ONLY (FOUO caveat partially illegible in the scan).

The DIA letter of 9 January 2018 lists entry 14 as 'Concepts for Extracting Energy from the Quantum Vacuum, Dr Eric Davis, EarthTech International'; the earlier KLAS list rendered the same entry as 'Vacuum Energy Applications'.

EarthTech International's own publication list for Eric W. Davis independently confirms the attribution and the document number: 'Davis, E. W. (2010), "Concepts for Extracting Energy From the Quantum Vacuum," Defense Intelligence Reference Document, Acquisition Threat Support, DIA-08-1004-007, Acquisition Support Division (DWO-3), Defense Warning Office, Directorate for Analysis, Defense Intelligence Agency, Washington, DC.'
The released cover page carries the date 6 April 2010, an Intelligence Cut-Off Date of 1 December 2009 and document number DIA-08-1004-007, matching EarthTech's citation exactly.

Davis and Harold Puthoff had published the same argument in the open literature the previous year as 'Chapter 18: On Extracting Energy from the Quantum Vacuum' in 'Frontiers of Propulsion Science' (AIAA, 2009), the volume Davis co-edited with Marc G. Millis.

connections.label: Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program (AAWSAP)
connections.note: The released document names the programme itself. Its inside cover reads 'This product is one in a series of advanced technology reports produced in FY 2009 under the Defense Intelligence Agency ... Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications (AAWSA) Program' - the redaction between them is (b)(3):10 USC 424. Verified by downloading this DIRD and scanning its full text on 23 August 2026. The scans are OCR-degraded, so the quotation is normalised from the damaged rendering.

connections.label: EarthTech International / Institute for Advanced Studies at Austin
connections.note: EarthTech, run by Hal Puthoff, was the largest single source of DIRDs, producing six of the 38. Puthoff has stated that BAASS 'connected me at EarthTech International to collaborate as a subcontractor' and that he then let the 38 contracts himself. The arrangement means EarthTech occupied both sides of the transaction on this document: commissioning agent and author's employer.
